📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-11-04
1. Binance discloses attack chain behind $6.34B crypto theft, starting with a fake job interview資安
Binance揭露63億美元竊案攻擊鏈，駭客以假面試誘使工程師執行惡意程式
Binance's preliminary investigation says attackers planted malware through a fake job interview, then used an internal AI tool to control other engineers' machines and reach the wallet-signing service. The intrusion traces back to June, when an engineer downloaded a tampered Homebrew installer.
Binance 公布初步調查：駭客透過假求職面試植入惡意程式，再利用內部 AI 工具控制其他工程師電腦，進而入侵錢包簽章服務。攻擊最早可追溯至 6 月，一名工程師下載了遭變造的 Homebrew 安裝程式。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180203
2. Anthropic open-sources FlashProve to cryptographically verify AI models haven't been swapped研究
Anthropic開源FlashProve，以密碼學驗證AI模型未遭掉包
FlashProve uses zero-knowledge proofs to confirm an AI response really came from the claimed model, without revealing model weights. Anthropic released the technical report, code and formal verification tools.
FlashProve 利用零知識證明，驗證 AI 回答確實來自指定模型，可偵測供應商私下換模型或輸出遭竄改，且不必公開模型權重。Anthropic 已公開技術報告、程式碼與形式化驗證工具。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180205
3. Apple opens Siri AI to third-party apps產品
蘋果開放第三方App整合Siri AI，可透過語音執行複雜任務
With the iOS 27.3 betas, all developers can integrate Siri AI into their apps, using natural language understanding, personal context and on-screen awareness. A new Skills mechanism lets Siri chain multiple actions together.
隨 iOS 27.3 測試版推出，所有開發者都能把 Siri AI 整合進自家 App，用於訂單查詢、餐廳預訂與購物等。新的 Skills 機制讓 Siri 能組合多項操作完成複雜任務。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180200
4. Google will let schools skip AI tools, but they must give up Search too政策
美國學校掀起AI禁令，Google推引導式學習爭取教育界接受
As large US school districts restrict generative AI, Google is adding Guided Learning to Search and Classroom. Schools can opt out of AI, but because AI is built into Search, doing so also turns off Google Search.
面對美國大型學區限制生成式 AI，Google 將引導式學習整合進搜尋與 Classroom。學校可自行決定是否開放，但拒絕 AI 就無法使用 Google 搜尋，引發爭議。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180199
5. Marvell to acquire Lumentum for $115B to combine AI chips and optical networking產業
Marvell砸1,150億美元收購Lumentum，整合AI晶片與光通訊技術
Marvell announced an all-stock deal to buy optical component maker Lumentum at an enterprise value of about $115 billion, expected to close in the first half of 2028. The combined company targets a $550 billion addressable market.
Marvell 宣布以全股票交易收購光通訊大廠 Lumentum，企業價值約 1,150 億美元，預計 2028 年上半年完成。雙方將整合 AI 晶片、網路交換與光通訊，預估合併後可服務市場達 5,500 億美元。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180171
6. OpenAI says ChatGPT is catching up to Google in search產業
OpenAI表示ChatGPT搜尋量正在追上Google
OpenAI says the volume of search queries run through ChatGPT now equals 20 percent of Google's. The figure was announced by Adam Fry, OpenAI's consumer product lead for ChatGPT.
OpenAI 表示，ChatGPT 的搜尋查詢量已相當於 Google 的 20%。這項數字由 ChatGPT 消費者產品負責人 Adam Fry 公布。
The Verge · https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1025482/openai-says-chatgpt-is-catching-up-to-google-in-search
7. New York Times and other outlets sue Brave over alleged content scraping政策
紐約時報等媒體控告Brave涉嫌擷取內容
The New York Times is suing Brave for allegedly scraping its copyrighted content and unlawfully distributing it to customers such as Anthropic and Perplexity.
紐約時報控告 Brave，指其涉嫌擷取受著作權保護的內容，並非法提供給 Anthropic、Perplexity 等客戶。
TechCrunch · https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/02/new-york-times-and-other-outlets-sue-web-browser-brave-over-alleged-content-scraping/
8. XCPE botnet controlled over 1.3 million set-top boxes; Google accuses Android maker of preloading a backdoor資安
XCPE殭屍網路控制逾130萬臺機上盒，Google指控Android裝置製造商刻意預載後門
Google's threat intelligence team disrupted the XCPE botnet, saying device maker Videostrong allegedly preloaded a firmware backdoor and sold access to criminal partners. Those partners used the devices for ad fraud and as proxy nodes.
Google 威脅情報團隊瓦解 XCPE 殭屍網路，指控裝置製造商 Videostrong 涉嫌在韌體預載後門並向犯罪夥伴販售存取權限，這些夥伴用受感染裝置從事廣告詐欺或充當代理節點。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180161
9. MIT demonstrates weight-space programming: GPT-6 Astra directly reads and writes neural network weights模型
MIT展示權重空間程式設計，GPT-6 Astra可直接讀寫神經網路權重
MIT CSAIL used GPT-6 Astra to edit Qwen3.5-0.8B's weights directly without retraining, lifting MATH-500 accuracy from 7.9% to 48.1%. The edit touched only about 0.016% of the weights.
MIT CSAIL 讓 GPT-6 Astra 直接修改 Qwen3.5-0.8B 的權重，不需重新訓練，MATH-500 正確率由 7.9% 升至 48.1%。修改範圍僅約 0.016% 的權重。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180195
10. AI inference startup Fal doubles its valuation to $16B as demand surges產業
AI推論新創Fal估值倍增至160億美元
The five-year-old startup raised a $1.3 billion round led by Bessemer, doubling its valuation as demand for AI inference grows.
這家成立五年的新創完成 13 億美元募資，由 Bessemer 領投，在 AI 推論需求暴增下估值翻倍。
TechCrunch · https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/03/ai-inference-startup-fal-doubles-its-valuation-to-16b-as-demand-surges/
